This article compares the distribution of the [[cha2ds2-vasc|CHA2DS2-VASc]] score among prevalent patients with [[atrieflimren]] across [[danmark|Danmark]] and its five regions. The CHA2DS2-VASc score is a critical clinical tool used to assess stroke risk in patients with atrial fibrillation, guiding decisions on anticoagulant therapy. Tracking these scores geographically and over time helps identify regional disparities in patient risk profiles and the growing burden of comorbidities.

Across the reporting periods, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] consistently recorded the highest average stroke risk, while [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] consistently recorded the lowest. In 2023, the national mean score was 1.47, with Region Sjælland leading at 1.54 and Region Hovedstaden trailing at 1.42 [^src1]. By 2024, the national mean had increased to 1.51, with Region Sjælland again posting the highest mean (1.57) and Region Hovedstaden the lowest (1.46) [^src2]. Despite these slight increases in the mean scores, the median score remained completely flat at 1.00 across all regions in both years [^src1] [^src2]. The maximum recorded score in the 2023 and 2024 summary tables was 6.00 [^src1] [^src2].

The total population of prevalent patients grew steadily over the three years. The national cohort expanded from 134,810 patients in 2023 [^src1] to 136,420 in 2024 [^src2], and reached 138,889 in 2025 [^src3]. The 2025 data provides a granular breakdown of the score distribution from 0 to 8 [^src3]. Nationally, the most frequent scores were 2 (26% of patients) and 3 (21%) [^src3]. [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] tied for the highest proportion of patients with a score of 2, each at 27% [^src3]. While the 2023 and 2024 tables capped the maximum score at 6, the 2025 distribution reveals that a very small number of patients had scores of 7 (406 patients nationally) and 8 (31 patients nationally), though they represented 0% of the total population [^src3].

- "Den sande prævalens af atrieflimren undervurderes, idet screeningsundersøgelser har påvist, at der findes et betydeligt antal patienter med uerkendt atrieflimren (Svennberg et al. Circulation 2015;131:2176-84)." — see [[limitation|Limitation]] ([[atrieflimren]]) [^src28]
